principles: Deterministic pre-registered arms (parity of hash(storyId)) so assignment is not gameable.
Shadow measurement: OFF arm still computes hints + fires the event, only the render is gated — no story loses data.
Advisory isolation: hints stay in _reviewPrompt, never in resolveReviewPromptHash or the issues/blocker logic.
Pure leaf: resolveHintMode is a pure function of storyId.
drivers: Unconfounded forward A/B (deterministic arms, no time/selection bias).
Preserve measurement on both arms for the 3.4 predictive-value metric.
Touch the REVIEW-gate handler minimally: issues/blocker + promptHash unchanged.

options.name: Shadow-gate the section render + hintMode on the event (chosen)
pros: Both arms measured; only display differs
cons: Slightly more code than a hard skip (acceptable; the shadow data is the point)

options.name: Hard-skip hint computation in OFF arm
cons: Loses the would-have-hinted measurement for OFF — breaks the 3.4 fast metric on half the corpus

options.name: Random per-call arm
cons: Non-deterministic/gameable; an arm could flip across calls within a story — confounds the RCT

chosen: Shadow-gate the section render + hintMode on the event (chosen)
rationale: Shadow-gating keeps both arms measured (essential for the 3.4 predictive-value metric) while giving only the ON arm the reviewer-facing nudge; deterministic arm assignment makes the RCT unconfounded and non-gameable; and because hints are already advisory-only (out of resolveReviewPromptHash and the blocker logic), gating the render perturbs nothing gated.

preMortem.scenario: Gating the section accidentally changes promptHash.
preMortem.trigger: _reviewPrompt feeds resolveReviewPromptHash, or the gating touches the reviewer-prompt channel.
preMortem.consequence: reviewRunId/promptHash changes between arms — breaks review evidence and confounds the experiment.
preMortem.mitigation: Hints are in the advisory _reviewPrompt only (B-1dc9 invariant); the smoke/verifier assert promptHash is byte-identical on/off; do not touch resolveReviewPromptHash.

preMortem.trigger: The OFF arm skips loadExperienceHints / the event.
preMortem.consequence: 3.4 cannot compute predictive value on OFF stories — the A/B is half-blind.
preMortem.mitigation: Compute hints + fire the event on BOTH arms (shadow); only the render is gated; the smoke asserts the event fires with hintMode=off on an OFF story.

preMortem.scenario: Arm assignment is non-deterministic or unbalanced.
preMortem.trigger: Using time/random, or a skewed hash.
preMortem.consequence: A story flips arms across calls (confound) or arms are lopsided.
preMortem.mitigation: resolveHintMode is a pure parity of sha256(storyId); the smoke asserts determinism (same id => same arm) and rough balance over many ids.

preMortem.trigger: Refactoring story-review.ts disturbs the blocker logic.
preMortem.mitigation: Only the advisory hint section + event payload change; the smoke/verifier assert issues/blocker output is unchanged by arm; no-hints path byte-identical.
